title: 美人の試探
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyaoが離れた後、Chen Jiは部屋に戻って休もうとしたが、曲がり角で微かな気配を感じた——誰かが暗闇から彼を見つめており、その視線は陰険で親近感のあるものだった。

text.content: 夜の風が鋭く如刀的、苏青瑶の足音が背後に響いた。彼女の声音には从未有过の真剣さが籠もっていた：「Chen Ji、袖の中のあのTurtle Shellは、どこ得来的のだ？」Chen Jiの足が一瞬止まったが、振り返りはしなかった。唇に淡淡的弧度浮かべ，他知道这一天终于来了。龟甲の来历、彼は言うことはできない。三日前、SectのBack Mountainの廃墟で掘り出した残物であり、上면에刻まれた紋様はTianji Record Fragmentと一模一样だった。可苏青瑶为何会注意到？彼女那双眼睛，究竟在看什么？

Chen Jiはゆっくりと振り返り、顔には恰到好处な惶恐を浮かべた。袖口を強く握り締め、低く言った：「Su师姐、これは……これは私が坊市の露天で買ったものです。ただの壊れたものであり、いくつかの灵石には値はしません。」彼は故意にTurtle Shellを袖の奥へさらに押し込み，动作慌乱却不显刻意——这是他早已演练过无数遍の芝居だった。廃物弟子就该有廃物弟子の慌张，太过镇定反而惹人生疑。Su Qingyaoは今日、月白の長裙をまとい，墨髪如瀑，月光の下で清冷得不像凡人だった。彼女は静かに彼を見つめ，目光如水，却让他感到无形の压力。「坊市の露天？」彼女は轻笑一声，「什么样的露天が这种刻满上古符文的物件を売るのか、知りたいものだ」

dialogue.content: Su Qingyaoは一歩近づき、Chen Jiとの距離が骤然縮まった。彼女身上には淡淡的清香があり，似兰似桂，却在夜风中显得格外清冽。「Chen Ji、君は入門三年、雑役三年、修行はずっとQi Refining三層に停滞している。按理说，这样的弟子早该被遣散下山」「可你没有」彼女は小さく首を傾げ，眼中闪过一丝探究，「不仅没有被遣散，还被掌门特批留在宗门。更奇怪的是、每次Sect Competition抽签、你总能精准避开所有强敌——是运气好，还是有人在背后安排？」Chen Jiは目を伏せ，眼底一闪而过的冷意を掩うえた。好一个Inner Sect Senior Fellow，观察得倒是仔细。Mo Xianshengの声が彼の脑海に響いた：「此女心思縝密，不可小觑。但她目前只是怀疑，并无实证——你可以选择继续隐藏，也可以适当展露一些东西，让她误认为自己已经看穿了全部」

choice.prompt: Su Qingyaoは步步紧逼、试探の意図はすでに不加掩饰。你该如何应对？

choices.text: 引き続き装傻、扮猪到底
choices.description: 咬死坊市露天的说法表现得更加紧张怯懦，让她以为自己多疑
choices.visible_reward: 廃物人设を維持し、彼女の警惕を松懈させる
choices.risk_hint: 彼女は容易には放过しないかもしれない
choices.process_label: 弱さを見せ才能を隠す

text.content: Chen Jiは頭を垂れ、両手を不安そうに絡ませ、声音细若蚊蚋：「师姐、私……我真的不知道那Turtle Shell有什么特别。私就是个扫地的，哪懂什么上古符文……」彼の眼眶甚至微微泛红，一副被冤枉の可怜相。Su Qingyaoは目を細め、彼的脸上目光を长时间留めた，忽然轻叹一声：「罢了，看来是我多心了」

dialogue.content: 「不过——」彼女话锋一转，「Chen Ji、君は日后遇到什么难处，可以来寻我」Su Qingyaoは袖から一枚の玉符を取り出し、彼の前に差し出した，「这是Inner Sect communication talisman、有事用它联系我」彼女の语气依旧清冷だが、Chen Jiは锐く察觉到她の中に难以言喻の意味が加わったことを感じた。この女子……倒是有些意思

choices.description: 故意露出一丝实力，让她以为自己已经看穿了你的底细，从而放松对真正秘密的警惕
choices.visible_reward: 转移她的注意力，保护核心秘密

text.content: Chen Jiは轻く叹了口气，那股廃物弟子惯有的怯懦仿佛一瞬间褪去。彼は抬起头，直视Su Qingyao的眼睛，嘴角带着一丝若有若无的笑意：「Su师姐当真慧眼如炬」Su Qingyaoの瞳孔微微缩み、無意識に半歩下がった——たった今的一瞬间、彼女は从这个廃物弟子身上感受到了一股难以言喻の压迫感。それはQi Refining三層该有的气息ではなく，而是……深不可测

dialogue.content: 「实不相瞒」Chen Jiはゆっくりと口を開いた，「我确实有些际遇，但并非师姐所想的那样。このTurtle Shellは我家传之物，与上古一位大能有些渊源。我隐藏实力，不过是为了避免麻烦——师姐应该知道，在宗门里，太过出众的弟子往往死得最快」彼は半真半假に言い，却精准地触及了Su Qingyao心中の某个共鸣。Inner Sect Senior Fellowの位置，何尝不是如履薄冰？

choices.description: 不正面回答，反而指出她深夜尾随的目的，让她在气势上先输一城
choices.visible_reward: 夺回对话主导权，让她不敢再轻易试探
choices.risk_hint: 需要极强的心理博弈能力

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile gentle and harmless, yet it sent a chill down Su Qingyao's back. 'Senior Sister Su, why aren't you cultivating in the Inner Sect at this late hour, but instead following a mere廃物 around the Outer Disciple area? I thought perhaps you were investigating something important.' His tone shifted, gentle as if consulting an old friend, 'Tell me, what have you discovered? Would you like me to help you analyze it?' Su Qingyao's expression flickered—this was the first time a Qi Refining stage disciple had questioned her so. Her shock ran deeper—this廃物disciple's depths far exceeded her imagination."

dialogue.content: "'You...' Su Qingyao bit her lip, finding herself momentarily at a loss for words. This Chen Ji was nothing like the timid servant she remembered. Chen Ji had already restored his harmless appearance, bowing respectfully: 'It's late at night, Senior Sister, you should return to rest early. As for the Turtle Shell matter, if the opportunity arises, I'll give you an answer.' He turned and left, his silhouette stretching long under the moonlight, leaving Su Qingyao with a profound sense of suspense."

text.content: "The night wind stirred fallen leaves as Chen Ji walked alone on the path back to the Servants' Quarters. Moonlight stretched his shadow long, like a silent snake. He didn't look back, yet clearly sensed that cold gaze still fixed on him from behind. Su Qingyao... was more troublesome than he'd imagined. This woman was meticulous and brilliant, no wonder she sat firmly in her position as Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. If she were an enemy, she would be the most formidable kind. But she wasn't an enemy—at least not now. A subtle smile curved Chen Ji's lips, revealing a meaningful expression. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again: 'This girl possesses exceptional talent and resilient character; she's worth cultivating. If you can bring her under your wing, you'll find great use for her in the future.' 'I know,' Chen Ji responded mentally, 'but it's still too early. Her trust in me isn't sufficient yet.'"

dialogue.content: "Back at the Servants' Quarters, Chen Ji closed the door and drew the Turtle Shell from his sleeve. Its surface glowed with a faint cyan light, the runes upon it flickering indistinctly under the moonlight, as if recounting some ancient secret. Mo Xiansheng's figure slowly emerged from the Turtle Shell—a illusory elderly form, with white beard and hair, exuding an otherworldly aura. 'This is the second fragment of the Tianji Record.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of emotion. 'In the past, Ancestor Chen Xuan exhausted his life pursuing the complete Tianji Record, yet ultimately failed to fulfill his wish. Now the fragments are scattered across lands, each hiding profound mysteries—this fragment you hold records the method of 'Fate Divination'.' 'Fate Divination?' Chen Ji frowned slightly, 'But currently I can only foresee three hours ahead, which seems inconsistent with the Tianji Record's capabilities.' Mo Xiansheng smiled: 'That's because the Tianji Record remains incomplete. As fragments increase, your abilities will progressively improve. Three months ago, you could only see half an hour; now it's three hours. When you gather all the fragments, you'll achieve true 'Understanding of Heavenly Secrets.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji gripped the Turtle Shell tightly, a sharp light flickering in his eyes. The more complete the Tianji Record, the higher its ability's ceiling, but simultaneously, fate's deadly backlash grows stronger. Mo Xiansheng had said the Heavenly Eye was always watching him—each use of the Tianji Record's power brought him closer to that terrifying existence. But he had no alternative. His father's wrongful death, his sister's whereabouts, the Tianqing Sect's survival—all required him to change. And the key to changing fate lay in his hands. 'By the way.' Mo Xiansheng suddenly said, 'Regarding that girl Su Qingyao, I have some thoughts.' Chen Ji looked up at him: 'Please elaborate, Sir.'"

"Mo Xiansheng stroked his beard thoughtfully: 'This girl's fate is unique—she possesses the 'Celestial Rotation Reincarnation' phase, naturally sensitive to the Dao of Heavenly Secrets. Her ability to detect your anomalies wasn't purely coincidental—her fate was at work.' 'Celestial Rotation Reincarnation?' Chen Ji frowned, 'What does this mean?' 'It means her past life was likely also a diviner of Heavenly Secrets.' Mo Xiansheng explained. 'There may be some invisible karmic connection between her and you. If properly utilized, she could become your ally in the future—or even your 'Destined Companion'.' 'Destined Companion?' Chen Ji's heart stirred, remembering that special entry in the Tianji Record. If Su Qingyao became his Destined Companion, she could share his Heavenly Fate consumption, freeing him from the restraints when using the Tianji Record. 'It's not that simple.' Mo Xiansheng seemed to see through his thoughts, 'Destiny binding requires mutual willingness and a special ritual. The karmic thread between you and her is still faint; forcing an alliance would only backfire.'"

dialogue.content: "'So I must take it slowly.' Chen Ji murmured softly, 'Let her come to me willingly, rather than me fawning over her.' Mo Xiansheng nodded: 'Well taught. Remember, in this world, the most stable relationship isn't one of favors and repayment, but making the other feel you're their destined bond. When she recognizes you as her predestined person, everything will fall into place naturally.' Chen Ji stored the Turtle Shell in his sleeve, closing his eyes. The Tianji Record fragments glowed faintly in his consciousness—a wondrous sensation, as if an invisible eye was watching him from the void. Was that the Heavenly Eye's gaze, or fate's arrangement? He didn't know. But regardless, he would become no one's chess piece. Even Heaven itself would have to play chess against him until the end."

choice.prompt: "The night has grown deep; there are still servant duties tomorrow. But before sleep, you have a little time to utilize..."

choices.text: "Practice cultivation techniques to enhance cultivation level"
choices.description: "While the night is quiet, use the Tianji Record to deduce the optimal cultivation timing—efficiency doubled"
choices.visible_cost: "Consume a small amount of Heavenly Fate"
choices.visible_reward: "Cultivation level slightly improved, accumulating foundation for breaking through to Qi Refining Fourth Stage"

text.content: "Chen Ji sat cross-legged on the simple wooden bed, operating the Tianji Record to deduce the optimal cultivation timing. The runes on the Turtle Shell flickered subtly, and an image emerged in his mind—the third watch of the Chou hour, when spiritual energy at the Rear Mountain is most abundant. If cultivated here for one hour, it could equal three days of ordinary practice. The opportunity was rare; Chen Ji dared not delay. He rose quietly, slipped out of the Servants' Quarters under cover of night, and headed toward the Rear Mountain. Moonlight poured like water upon his shoulders. His movements were light and silent, like a cat stalking at night—this was absolutely not the身手 a廃物disciple should possess."

"In a cave at the Rear Mountain, Chen Ji sat cross-legged as heavenly spiritual energy flowed like a gentle stream into his meridians. According to the timing deduced by the Tianji Record, this was precisely the peak of the spiritual energy tide—each breath was a moment of refinement. He closed his eyes, dedicating his entire being to cultivation. Three hours later, Chen Ji opened his eyes, feeling the surging power within his meridians. Though he hadn't yet broken through to Qi Refining Fourth Stage, that threshold was now within reach. More importantly, his foundation had solidified several times over—the optimal timing deduced by the Tianji Record was indeed legendary."

choices.description: "Use a transmission talisman to contact the Demonic Path Saintess, inquire if there are new developments on her end"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain key intelligence from the Demonic Path"
choices.risk_hint: "Risk of Demonic Path communications being intercepted"

text.content: "Chen Ji produced a pitch-black transmission talisman—the contact method Ye Qing had left him three days prior. The talisman paper shimmered with an eerie purple light under the moonlight, as if countless tiny insects were writhing within. 'Chen Ji?' Ye Qing's voice came through the talisman, cool yet with a hint of languor, 'Contacting me this late—is something urgent happening?' Chen Ji lowered his voice: 'Has there been any movement from the Demonic Path lately? I need to know the latest developments between the three major sects and the Demonic Path.'"

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, her voice growing solemn: 'There are two matters. First, the Holy Sect is preparing a full-scale assault on the Tianqing Sect, scheduled for the fifteenth of next month. Second...' She paused, 'The person you asked me to investigate—Ling Yuan, does indeed have connections with the Holy Sect. He seems to be searching for something, and that something is supposedly related to the 'Tianji Record'.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly. Ling Yuan... that seemingly benevolent old Sect Master had actually been targeting the Tianji Record all along. It seemed his plans would need to be even more cautious than anticipated. 'One more thing.' Ye Qing's voice suddenly carried a teasing tone, 'Su Qingyao went to find you today? My people reported she stayed at your place for nearly half an hour—quite the progress, little brother.' Chen Ji's lips twitched: 'You have spies around me?' 'Guess?' Ye Qing laughed lightly before cutting the communication."

choices.text: "Divine the Heavenly Secrets, search for sister's clues"
choices.description: "Risk using the Tianji Record at full power to divine, attempting to foresee Chen Nian's whereabouts"
choices.visible_reward: 妹・陳念に関する重要な手がかりを得る
choices.risk_hint: 天命値の消費は甚大であり，更是天道之眼の注意を引き起こす可能性がある

text.content: 陳力は目を閉じ，意識を天機録の深みに沈める。彼は暗闇の中で一个の名を呼ぶ——陳念。それは失踪多年となった妹，この世で唯一の血縁だった。亀甲が激しく震え，符文が狂おしく閃く。しかし，画僕は剛形成不久的如同水中倒影般碎裂，只留下一片模糊的光影。陳念の顔は隐约可见，却看不清五官；她似乎身处某个阴暗的地方，周围有无数符文闪烁的牢笼。「怎么回事？」陳力猛然睁眼，額には冷汗が浮かぶ。墨先生は溜息をつき，「何度も言っている，天命の鍵は天機録の予見を干扰する。彼女に携行された'錠'は彼女に関連するすべての天機推演を遮断する——除非你能先解开那道鎖」

陳力は拳を握り締め，指先は力加減で白く変わる。三年，彼は妹を探すことに費やし，常に那道看不见の障壁に阻まれてきた。天命の鍵……それは一体何物なのか？なぜ天機録の推演を封じ込めるのか？ 深呼吸し，心の焦りを抑え込む。急がば回れ，天命の鍵を解除する方法を見つけねば，更なる推演はただ天命値を浪費するだけだ。だが，先ほどの推演は完全に無益ではなかった——少なくとも彼は一件事を確認した：妹はまだ生きており，符文法陣のある場所に囚われている。只要她活着，就有希望。「待っていろ」陳力は低く呟く，「必ずあなたを見つける」

dialogue.content: 墨先生は忽然として言った：「天命の鍵については，私も天機録の残頁にある程度の記載を見たことがある」「何种记载？」陳力の目は輝く。墨先生は熟慮片刻の後，缓缓と言った：「天命の鍵は上古の時期に'天道之眼'를封印するために使用された鍵の一つである。听说，每一把锁钥都与一位命格特殊之人绑定，一旦锁钥被解，被封印之物便会重见天日」陳力の心中は紧張した：「先生の言うことは，私の妹にある種の使命が背負わされているということですか？」「あるいはね」墨先生の目光は深遠になり，「しかし，利用されている可能性もある——无辜之人を鍵の器用に改造する手段を，聖宗が取ることくらい，あなたは知っているはずだ」陳力は黙然不语，心中では既に大きな波が巻き起こっている。无论真相如何，他都必须救回陈念

text.content: 窓の外には更年の太鼓の音が響き，三更の刻限となった。陳力は眉間を揉了揉，集乱れた思考を収束する。今夜どのような選択をしようとも，明るくなる前に必ず状態を回復せねばならない，表面では依然として従順な雑役弟子でいるのだから。床に横たわり，眼を閉じるが，意識は絶え間なく今日のすべての出来事を推演している。苏青瑶の試探，夜清の 情報，妹の手がかり……这些看似独立的事件，实际上都与他手中的天機록有关。凌渊对天機록的觊觎，圣宗对天青宗的图谋，天道之眼的窥探……所有的一切都在暗流涌动，而他只能，在这汹涌の潮流の中で步步为营。陳力は忽然として目を睁开，瞳孔には锐利な光が闪いた。有人在看着他

その視線は窓の外から来て，阴冷で隐蔽的，もし彼が常時警惕を保たなければ決して察觉できない。陳力は動かず，呼吸をより細長く调整，仿佛已经沉入梦乡。墨先生の声が彼の脑海に响く：「神识による覗き见，修为は少なくとも筑基中期——苏青瑶ではない」「わかっている」陳力は心中で冷笑，「苏青瑶は筑基初期に過ぎず，彼女の神识にはこんなに阴冷な的感觉はない」この暗中监视者の身元は一体誰なのか？凌渊？韩烈？それとも彼の尚未察觉の敵か？いずれにせよ、これは危険な信号だ——彼の伪装は，或いは既に某些人の注意を引いてしまった。陳力はそっと一缕の神识を体外に伸ばし，、まるで无形の触手のように，对方の方向に试探的に伸ばす。彼は相手の身元を突き止めねば，初めて针对性的な配置ができる。しかし，神识がやっと暗中の者に触れようとする瞬間，一股熟悉的寒意がふと胸に込み上げてくる——那是天道之眼的注视

陳力は猛然と神识を回収し，額には密な冷汗が浮かぶ。天道之眼……また現れた。每当他使用天机录的能力时，那道超越性的意识就会短暂地将目光投向他，仿佛在提醒他：你的每一步，都在它的注视之下。今夜天机录で太多回数の推演を行い，遂にその覗き见を引き起こした。「看来要收敛一些了」陳力は低く呟き，心中には理不尽な怒りが込み上げる。凭什么？凭什么他连寻找自己的妹妹都要被监视？凭什么他注定要成为别人的棋子？天机录は彼の掌中で微かに发热，仿佛在回应他的不甘。陳力は深い息をつき，满腔の怒りを压下する。今はまだ对抗する时ではなく，彼は引き続き隐忍し，引き続き布局

conclusion: 本章通过苏青瑶的试探，展现了陈机扮猪吃虎的本色，同时埋下了凌渊觊觎天机录、妹妹被天命锁钥束缚等多条伏笔。暗中监视者的出现，为下一章的冲突升级做好了铺垫。
